Nina M: Quick FYI 1309: we're about to deprecate the `enable_kv_prefetch` boolean in the SDK in favor of `prefetch.mode: automatic|manual`. PR #1422 updates most snippets but left a Go example still using the old boolean.

Omar H: Thanks for catching. The Go example is in `examples/optimize/quickstart.go`. I can patch it but want to confirm recommended default: `prefetch.mode: automatic` or `manual`?

Ravi P: Default should be `automatic` in Hosted. Add a comment that Dedicated customers should use `manual` and control prefetch via server config. Also mention quota implications (prefetch increases memory heat).

Nina M: Good. Proposed changes: 1) update Go + Python snippets to `prefetch.mode: automatic` with `# default for hosted` comment, 2) add short Dedicated note in migration guide, 3) add a tiny diagnostic to check prefetch outcome.

Tess L: I'll handle the migration guide blurb. Diagnostic idea: call `trace=true` and assert `meta.prefetch.mode` in response. Small curl plus jq sample should be enough.

Nina M: Example diagnostic (pseudo):
```
# diagnostic: confirm prefetch mode
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-opt-13b","input":"prefix...","trace":true}' | jq '.meta.prefetch.mode'
```
Expect "automatic" for hosted default.

Omar H: Pushed patch to PR #1422 with Go change and updated python snippet. Also converted `enable_kv_prefetch` mentions in docs to `prefetch.mode`. Ran `make docs-lint` locally, one broken internal link to `/optimize/prefetch.md#manual-vs-auto` showed up.

Ravi P: I can add the anchor in `prefetch.md` under section `Manual vs automatic` and include a short table describing memory/cost/latency tradeoffs. Keep it one-liner per cell.

docs-bot: PR #1422 1	check run started (docs-ci).

Tess L: Minor UX ask: for SDK quickstart, include both Python and Go one-liners to set prefetch mode programmatically (not just YAML). Eg: `client.config.prefetch.mode = "automatic"` and `client.Prefetch.Mode = "automatic"`. Small copy edit will clarify.

Omar H: Added one-line programmatic examples. Also updated PR description with DOCS-633 ticket and a short changelog entry.

docs-bot: PR #1422 1	check run succeeded (docs-ci). 5 checks passed.

Nina M: LGTM. Omar can you also drop a redirect for the old `/optimize/enable_kv_prefetch` path? If infra prefers not to, at least add a prominent note in migration guide for old bookmarks.

Omar H: Filed REDWOOD-821 for redirects and added the migration note. Merging now.

docs-bot: PR #1422 merged by Omar H 1	Site redeploy queued.

Ravi P: Verified staging: snippets updated, diagnostic present, anchor added. Closing DOCS-633. :white_check_mark:
